title: Confirm intent-2 (high): 0.3 um double step in route_l1_1 costs 1.8 dB on average, 0.9 to 2.8 dB chip to chip, from a TE0/TE1 beat between the two steps
evidence: Local mode solves of RWG1000 (work/physics/two_step.py): TE0 n_eff 1.7915, TE1 1.6604 (guided, te 0.97), slab 1.647. Each 0.3 um step: |c(TE0->TE0)|^2 = 0.812 (0.90 dB, = rv.junction_loss), |c(TE0->TE1)|^2 = 0.092, TM and slab < 0.003. TE1 stays guided along the 92.35 um straight and recouples at the second step: T = |a0^2 e^{i b0 L} - a1^2 e^{i b1 L}|^2. Beat phase 2*pi*0.131*92.35/1.55 = 49 rad, which moves by ~0.5 rad per 1% change in delta-n, so per chip the loss is anywhere in 0.88 to 2.85 dB (nominal 1.40 dB; phase average 1.8 dB). With the R=80 bend-mode shift (0.26 / 0.34 um effective offsets, microscope-1) the range is 0.91 to 2.84 dB. TE1 then enters the second R=80 bend, where my bend solve gives the TE1-like mode >1000 dB/cm, so it is radiated and does not unbalance MMI#3. Beat period in wavelength: lambda^2/(dn_g L) = 1.55^2/(0.172*92.35) ~ 150 nm, i.e. a spectral tilt of up to ~1 dB across the C-band on EC#12..EC#15.
impact: 0.9 to 2.8 dB (mean 1.8 dB) on the 4 lower outputs EC#12..EC#15; value not predictable chip to chip; tilts their spectrum.
fix: Put the vertical straight of route_l1_1 back on x=656.75 (centre of both bends), as in route_l1_0.

title: intent-5 is high: route_out_6 R=25 double bend costs ~1.3 dB once the TE1 beat in the 11.85 um straight is counted (worst-case phase)
evidence: work/physics/bend_trans.py, r25_coherent.py (local solves): R=25 TE0 n_eff 1.7959, 38.37 dB/cm -> 0.151 dB per 90-deg arc (0.30 dB for two). Straight<->bend TE0 overlap 0.178 dB per joint at R=25 (0.013 dB at R=80, solver floor ~0.003 dB at the best offset). Bend1 -> straight: |c|^2 TE0 0.960, TE1 0.027. The 11.85 um straight between the CCW and the CW bend is one TE0/TE1 beat length: (1.7915-1.6604)*11.85/1.55 = 1.002 periods, so the TE1 part arrives on the wrong side for the opposite bend (as an S-bend with no straight): middle transmission |0.960 - 0.027|^2 = 0.869 = 0.61 dB (0.36 dB if TE1 were ignored; best case 0.24 dB needs a pi phase that 11.85 um does not give). Total = 0.18 (MMI->bend1) + 0.61 (bend1->bend2) + 0.18 (bend2->straight) + 0.30 (radiation) = ~1.27 dB, vs ~0.05 dB for the R=80 s-bend siblings. Sidewall-roughness loss, larger in a tight rib bend, only adds. This puts it above the 1 dB line (twins-5/rules-5/microscope-6 give 0.9 to 1.0 dB without the beat).
impact: ~1.2 to 1.3 dB extra on EC#14 (plus the 0.9-2.8 dB of intent-2 and 0.06 dB of intent-6 on the same path); +21.09 um path length (0.15 ps skew).
fix: Replace route_out_6 by the R=80 s-bend used by route_out_7 (mirror), which also restores the length.

title: Confirm intent-3 (high): 10 um slab-only section in route_l2_2 = 4.6 dB lateral diffraction + 0.3 dB vertical mismatch per end, ~5.2 dB
evidence: work/physics/gap.py: the slab (0-0.2 um LN film) is drawn everywhere by the technology (empty mask) and LN_SLAB only protects it inside SLAB_NEGATIVE, so the gap is a bare 200 nm slab. Ridge TE0 projected on the slab TE0 vertical profile: eta_v = 0.934 (0.30 dB per ridge end). Lateral field then propagated with the exact angular spectrum in n_slab 1.657 and projected back: L=0.5 um 0.07 dB, 1 um 0.26, 2 um 0.78, 5 um 2.47, 10 um 4.59 dB. Total for 10 um: 5.2 dB. Agrees with twins-11 (5.4 dB EME), intent-c2 (4.7-5.3), rules-2 (~6). rv.junction_loss(layer2='LN_SLAB') = 4.66 dB per joint is a different quantity (overlap with a laterally boxed slab mode), not the section loss.
impact: ~5 dB on EC#12 and EC#13 (both outputs of MMI#6).
fix: Move the 10 x 1 um rectangle at x 1546.846..1556.846 from LN_SLAB (3/0) to LN_RIDGE (2/0).

title: Confirm intent-4 (medium): 0.5 um ridge gap on the common input, 0.07 dB lateral + up to 0.6 dB vertical, 0.1 to 0.7 dB on all 8 outputs
evidence: work/physics/gap.py: lateral diffraction over 0.5 um in the slab = 0.07 dB; vertical ridge->slab projection 0.30 dB per end, an upper bound for a 0.5 um gap because the unguided part has no room to leave and partly recouples. Bracket 0.07-0.67 dB, same as rules-1 (0.3-0.7, 2D x-z), intent-c1 (0.08-0.6), microscope-3 (0.2-1.4 upper bound). Back-reflection: modal index step 1.7915 -> 1.657 gives ~-28 dB per ridge end, up to ~-22 dB for the 0.5 um cavity: small next to the facet.
impact: 0.1 to 0.7 dB on every output (common path); LVS open.

title: Confirm intent-1 (high): EC#13 3.0 um off the 127 um grid = 13 to 17 dB fibre-array coupling loss
evidence: Gaussian facet mode, field overlap exp(-d^2/w0^2): MFD 3.0 um (w0 1.5) -> 17.4 dB at d=3.0 um; MFD 3.5 um -> 12.8 dB. A 0.5 um offset would already cost 0.5 dB. Only a separately aligned lensed fibre recovers it; with the 8-fibre array of the intent the channel is effectively dead.
impact: EC#13 output lost (>12 dB) at the fibre array, on top of the ~5 dB of intent-3 on the same output.
fix: Place EC#13 at y=-190.5 and redraw route_out_5 with the 61.85 um s-bend.

title: Confirm intent-6 (medium): 0.6 um section = 0.06 dB but a group-delay skew of 6.6 um equivalent length and twice the phase sensitivity to width
evidence: My local solves: w=1.0 n_eff 1.7915 n_g 2.1898; w=0.6 n_eff 1.7416 n_g 2.1505; junction_loss(1.0,0.6)=0.030 dB x2. Only TE0 guided at 0.6 um (no new mode). Over 367.05 um: group path -14.4 um (= -6.6 um of RWG1000, 13x the +-0.5 um rule), phase -18.3 um (11.8 waves). dn_eff/dw: ~0.15 /um at 0.6 um vs ~0.075 /um at 1.0 um, so the branch to EC#14/#15 carries twice the width-to-phase noise. Loss is small; the matching intent is broken.
impact: 0.06 dB on EC#14/#15; delay/phase skew of that branch.

title: Confirm intent-7 (medium): 0.4 um x 2 um neck, 0.08 to 0.33 dB on EC#8..EC#11
evidence: junction_loss(1.0,0.4)=0.167 dB per step (0.4 um still guides TE0, n_eff 1.705, symmetric: no TE1). Two independent steps = 0.33 dB is the upper end; over 2 um the 3.8 % unguided part stays near the ridge (lateral diffraction over 2 um only 0.78 dB of that part) and partly recouples, so ~0.1 dB is the low end. Bracket 0.08-0.33 dB (microscope-5 EME 0.15-0.58). Above the 0.05 dB defect line in all cases.
impact: 0.1 to 0.3 dB on the 4 upper outputs.

title: Confirm intent-8 (low): R=100 s-bend has no loss cost (R>=50 is radiation-free in my table); only the -2.28 um length
evidence: Bend table: R=80 0.02, R=60 0.01, R=50 -0.07 dB/cm (noise); straight/bend joint loss falls with R (0.013 dB at R=80, less at R=100). -2.28 um length = 0.017 ps skew.
fix: Use the R=80 s-bend of the siblings.

title: Confirm intent-10 and intent-9 (none): 10 nm step = 0.001 dB; 0.3 um MMI#5 shift fully absorbed
evidence: Offset table (rv.junction_loss): 0.025 um 0.006 dB, 0.05 0.025, 0.1 0.10 dB; quadratic, so 0.01 um -> 0.001 dB per joint. MMI#5: joints on axis (twins-9, microscope-9), no loss.
